recipeMethod: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Arrange cabbage wedges on a lined roasting tray with the core holding each wedge together. Brush with olive oil and season with 2 g salt and half the pepper. Roast for 30–40 minutes, turning halfway, until the thickest core is tender and edges browned.
Meanwhile melt butter in a saucepan over a medium-low heat. Stir in garlic for 30 seconds, add flour and stir for 1 minute without browning. Whisk in milk gradually to make a smooth sauce.
Simmer the sauce gently for 3–4 minutes until thickened. Take off the heat, stir in mustard and grated Cheddar, then add the remaining salt and pepper. Fold in drained haricot beans.

Return to a low heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring gently, until the beans are piping hot. Add a small splash of hot tap water only if the sauce becomes too thick; do not boil hard after adding the cheese.
Serve two roast cabbage wedges per person over a quarter of the Cheddar beans. Cool leftovers within 2 hours, refrigerate and use within 48 hours, reheating once until steaming throughout.
